objective: Deploy the exact corrected recipient-access product candidate to the existing public KEP Devnet service while preserving PostgreSQL state and prohibiting protocol transactions.

product_precondition.required_decision: An owner product-approval decision must bind these exact three digests before deployment authorization becomes eligible.

current_state_guard.guard_rule: Before the first effect, one read-only SSH observation must prove every private guard remains exact and required new paths are absent; any drift stops execution.

exact_remote_material.environment_transformation: Replace only the exact KEP_IMAGE line in the reconstructed current mode-0600 environment.

recovery_material.rollback_posture: Preserve only; rollback requires separate authorization.

database_effect.startup_behavior: Re-evaluate existing idempotent migrations 001 and 002 only.
database_effect.forbidden: No restore, deletion, drop, volume replacement, database recreation, credential change, or destructive migration.

allowed_effects_in_order: validate an exact product-approval decision bound to the frozen product candidate, material, and test digests
perform one read-only SSH current-state and required-path-absence preflight; stop before effects on mismatch
create one fresh nonempty mode-0600 PostgreSQL custom-format dump
upload the exact archive once and verify remote digest and size
load the archive once, require the exact tag, and require semantic projection b34a1500 while recording the remote engine image ID
copy the active Compose and mode-0600 environment to exact rollback paths
derive and atomically promote the exact mode-0600 next environment while leaving Compose unchanged
run docker compose up -d --no-build once for only kep-hosted-devnet
perform bounded application health, unchanged database ID and volume, public HTTPS, exact root and bundle bytes, TLS, and Solana Devnet identity reads
stop_conditions: any current-state, path, credential-mode, archive, dump, image, environment, activation, health, database, volume, HTTPS, TLS, network, root, or bundle mismatch
any failed or ambiguous external effect
forbidden_effects: Mainnet, paid RPC fallback, protocol transaction, signature request, wallet use, or SOL transfer
credential output, replacement, or reuse outside this deployment
database restore, deletion, drop, recreation, volume removal, image pruning, or destructive migration
unrelated VPS mutation, source substitution, automatic retry, or automatic rollback
publication, release, Git commit, Git push, reissue, or cleanup

claim_limit: Exact deployment preparation only. It does not authorize or prove product approval, SSH effects, backup, upload, image load, activation, deployment, reissue, publication, or release.
